info.title: Serialized Data API
info.description: On-chain data for trading apps - tokens, candles, token filters. Built on our own indexers. 18 EVM chains + Solana, live.

servers.description: Demo: no key needed, read endpoints, rate-limited per IP
Production: your API key in the Authorization header

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Your raw API key (not needed on the demo server).

get.description: Chains covered by the audit engine.

Full Serialized Audit verdict for a contract: safety verdict, vulnerabilities, ownership/renounce state, proxy detection, open-source status. Async-first: an already-audited token answers inline; a new one starts the audit and returns a progress status to re-poll.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` (audit covers EVM only).

get.description: Supported chains with status. Free.
Launchpad and factory keys of the registry: `factories` lists every key, `byChain` the keys the `factories=` filter of `/v1/pulse` accepts for each chain. EVM and Solana. Free.

Static definition of one market (pool): pair address, venue/DEX, base & quote token metadata, fee tier, created-at. Slow-changing - cache-friendly. A market id is simply chain + pool address: stable, unique on its venue, never reused.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Live snapshot of one market, safe to poll at high frequency: last price, per-window volume, liquidity, market cap, circulating + total supply, buys/sells and unique traders per window (5m/1h/24h). Buy/sell tax and the full security fields live on `/v1/token/security`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Historical OHLCV for one market, addressed by pool. Same engine and intervals as `/v1/token/ohlcv` (1s to 1M), deep backfill.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Candles per page, 1-500 (default 200). Honoured whenever the history allows it, however quiet the token is.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix SECONDS, inclusive upper bound (pagination: prev oldestTime - 1). At most 1 day ahead; a millisecond value is rejected (400).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix SECONDS, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there). A millisecond value is rejected (400).

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: usd converts each candle at its bucket rate (solana only for now)

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only.

get.description: Trade tape of one market: recent + historical, time-bounded, cursor pagination, optional participant filter. Each trade carries a stable id, timestamp (ms), price, size, side, maker and tx hash.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: toAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: washFilter
parameters.description: Keep only wash-tagged or only organic transactions (solana only)

post.description: The tape of up to 200 markets in a single call, since a timestamp - grouped per market, per-market row cap. One request replaces a full polling fan-out.

markets.description: List of `{chain, address}` pools (up to 200 per call).

from.description: Only trades at/after this time (unix MILLISECONDS, at most 24h back; a value in seconds is rejected with 400). Page the per-market tape for history.

get.description: Live USD prices of every chain's native coin, with per-symbol freshness (`updatedAt`, `stale`) - you always know how fresh a price is.

Axiom-style launchpad lifecycle columns: `new` (created under 24h), `bonding` (active curves, sorted by bonding %), `graduated` (migrated or virtually-graduated, last 7 days). ~90 launchpads tracked natively across 18 EVM chains, bonding thresholds per factory.

parameters.name: isOG
parameters.description: first token with this ticker on the chain

get.description: Every tradable market, paginated: filters by chain, sort by volume, market cap or creation time, per-window stats on every row, cursor pagination. The discovery primitive - poll it to detect new markets.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: CSV of public chain ids (1-8). sortBy=createdAt serves ONE chain per call (indexed walk) - fan out per chain.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: `volume` (default), `marketCap` or `createdAt`. volume/marketCap rank within each chain's own universe (top 300 by 24h volume plus top 100 by 1h volume, named in `meta.universe`); `window` selects the rank window for `volume`.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Rank window for `sortBy=volume`: `5m`, `1h`, `6h` or `24h` (default `24h`, the relevance ranking).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `meta.nextCursor`. Pins the computation each page was cut from, so a walk started within the last minute never skips or repeats a market.

get.description: Low-latency token search: exact address (EVM hex, Solana base58, pool addresses) or free-text name/symbol (trigram). Covers BOTH families: `chain=solana` or `chain=evm:<id>` restricts; no chain searches EVM and Solana in parallel and merges by USD liquidity. Results carry price, liquidity, market cap, 24h volume and 1h/24h price change.

Full token snapshot: price (native + USD), market cap & FDV (sanity-capped), liquidity (+ATH), best pool (canonical priority ranking), launchpad state (bonding progress, graduation), deployer, 24h stats, metadata & socials.

post.description: Full-detail batch twin: up to 25 `{chain, address}` items (EVM and Solana can be mixed in one call), response array in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

get.description: Every token deployed by a wallet, with a verdict on each (`active`, `migrated`, `rugged`, `abandoned`) and an aggregate risk read on the deployer: totals per status, graduation success rate, risk level, first and last deploy. Pass `address` to evaluate the deployer BEHIND a token (we resolve it), or `wallet` to query a deployer directly.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address - its deployer is resolved first. Required unless `wallet` is given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1-100. Default 50. `meta.truncated` tells you the stats only describe the returned page.

get.description: Top holders with position size, share of supply, full PnL (realized + unrealized), buy/sell volumes, behavioral labels and named entities (exchanges, funds - the "Coinbase" signal). EVM and Solana.
Socials, description, images, dex-paid status. POST twin on the same path for batches (≤100, billed per item).

Chart-ready candles from 1s to 1M. Token-wide by default (the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration), or an explicit set of up to 50 pools. Wick-outlier clamping and candle connecting included. On Base, the forming candle includes preconfirmed (flashblocks) swaps ~2.5s before block commit.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to aggregate; default: the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Candles per page, 1-500 (default 200). Honoured whenever the history allows it, however quiet the token is.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix SECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 1 day ahead; a millisecond value is rejected with 400). Paginate back with the previous `meta.oldestTime - 1` while `meta.hasMore` is true.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix SECONDS, inclusive lower bound (scans stop there). A millisecond value is rejected (400).

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: `native` (default) or `usd` (Solana) - usd converts each candle at its bucket's SOL/USD rate from our in-house minute-grade price history.

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Dense time axis (default true): a flat zero-volume candle for every bucket without a trade. `false` returns traded buckets only.

get.description: The markets of a token - rank 1 is the exact pool the token endpoint prices from, then every other market ranked by 24h volume and liquidity.
Cheap price tier for bots and tickers: price, market cap, liquidity. Nothing else.

post.description: Batch twin - up to 100 tokens in one call, one SQL round-trip. Response in input order; missing tokens come back as per-item `{error}` slots.

get.description: Per-family security fields. Solana: mint/freeze authority state (on-chain truth). EVM: holders count, top-10 concentration (CEX-custody excluded), dev/snipers/bundlers holdings %, token burn %, buy/sell/transfer tax (on-chain simulation), dexPaid. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id. `solana` for now; EVM ships with the LP burn/lock indexing (explicit 400 until then, never silent nulls).

post.description: Per-family security fields. Solana: mint/freeze authority state (on-chain truth). EVM: holders count, top-10 concentration (CEX-custody excluded), dev/snipers/bundlers holdings %, token burn %, buy/sell/transfer tax (on-chain simulation), dexPaid. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

items.description: Up to 100 of `{chain, address}`, across chains. Response array is in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

post.description: Small native-price arrays for list rows - one call for up to 100 pools. Timeframes 1m|5m|30m|1h|24h|7d. Missing pools return [] - we never invent data.

pools.description: Pool addresses (up to 100). Billing is per pool; missing pools return `[]`.

get.description: Windowed volume, buy/sell counts and volumes, price change - 5m/1h/6h/24h in one call.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to restrict the windows to; default token-wide (every pool of the token).

get.description: Ranked traders of a token, from our own PnL fold (per wallet and token): realized PnL in native and USD, tokens bought/sold, open position, average entry, win rate over closed positions, first/last trade. Default sort is `pnl` on both families; `sortBy` accepts `pnl`, `bought`, `sold` or `txns`.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: all = lifetime PnL fold; 1h→30d = windowed recompute

get.description: Real-time trade tape. `maker` is the trader behind the swap, resolved through relays, solvers and smart accounts, with isProTrader/isSniper badges on every row. On Base, preconfirmed (flashblocks) trades appear ~2.5s before block commit, flagged per row. Filters: side, USD/native/token amount ranges, date range, makers (POST twin, up to 2000). Cursor pagination.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to restrict the tape; default token-wide (every pool of the token).

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: toAt
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: washFilter
parameters.description: `washOnly` or `organicOnly` - filter by the per-transaction wash badge (solana; every row carries `isWash`).

pools.description: CSV of pool addresses (≤50) restricting the scope; default = token-wide

fromAt.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive lower bound. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

toAt.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, inclusive upper bound (at most 7 days ahead). A value in seconds is rejected (400).

washFilter.description: Keep only wash-tagged or only organic transactions (solana only)

get.description: Every position a wallet has fully exited: total bought and sold (USD and native), realized PnL in absolute and percent, buy/sell counts and last trade time. The realized counterpart of `/v1/wallet/positions` - the realized PnL of every position lands in exactly one of the two. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` or `solana`. Omit for all EVM chains.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token addresses (1-50) to scope the response to: the realized PnL of those tokens, without paging the whole wallet.

get.description: Total wallet value (USD) as a time series over a chosen window - the equity curve behind every portfolio chart.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unix MILLISECONDS, default now. A value in seconds is rejected (400).

get.description: Where a wallet got its first funds: the earliest native transfer that funded it - funder address, timestamp, transaction and amount, with an entity tag (exchange, bridge…) when the funder is known. The primitive behind insider and sybil heuristics.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

get.description: Realized PnL of a wallet: daily curve plus summary (total realized, win rate, trades, wins/losses). Omit `chain` to combine every EVM chain; `chain=solana` for Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains combined.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` (default) or `all`. A period keeps the UTC days from now minus that many days through today, both inclusive: `7d` spans 8 calendar days, `1d` yesterday and today.

get.description: Every position of a wallet with entry price and PnL: amount held, USD value, average entry, realized + unrealized + total PnL, trade counts and first/last trade timestamps. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token addresses (1-50) to scope the response to - positions and summary cover only those tokens.

parameters.name: minValueUsd
parameters.description: Only positions whose `amountUsd` reaches this floor. Default 0.05 (dust removed); pass 0 to lift the floor. A traded position whose value is unknown is always listed; `meta.summary` still covers every position of the wallet.

get.description: Who is behind an address: display name, avatar, ENS / Basename / .sol, bio, social accounts (Twitter, Farcaster, GitHub…), follower counts, sources, pro-trader flag - plus `linkedWallets`, other addresses of the same person (cross-wallet identity clusters). Built on our identity graph of 7.6M+ labeled wallets across EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58).

post.description: Batch twin: up to 100 addresses per call, response array in input order, `null` slots for wallets without a known identity (identities are harvested continuously - retry later, never assume permanent).

items.description: `[{ "address": "…" }]` - 1 to 100 items, EVM and Solana mixed freely.

get.description: Trade history of a wallet, newest first - multihop-deduplicated (one event per transaction, token and side; never doubled volumes). Paginate with the opaque `cursor` from `meta.nextCursor` on both EVM and Solana: exact keyset pagination that never skips or repeats a trade. The intermediate legs of routed swaps (the wSOL, stable or quote a route passes through) are excluded by default - pass `includeRoutingHops=true` to see them, flagged `isRoutingHop`. Wash/MEV rows are NOT filtered and carry the `isWash` badge - consumers choose; `isWash` is `null` on EVM (no equivalent stamp).

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: beforeAt
parameters.description: Upper bound, unix MILLISECONDS: trades strictly older. A value in seconds is rejected (400). Prefer `cursor` for exact pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque resume token from `meta.nextCursor` - exact keyset pagination on both EVM and Solana, no skip or duplicate.

parameters.name: includeRoutingHops
parameters.description: Also serve the intermediate legs of routed swaps, flagged `isRoutingHop`. Default false.

get.description: Token in/out history of a wallet: deposits, withdrawals, plain transfers - timestamp (ms), token, amount, direction, counterparty, tx hash. The reconciliation primitive next to `/v1/wallet/trades`.
